name: SK Hynix

THE FRAMEWORK GATE OF ₩1,867,213 IS NOW ₩545,213 ABOVE THE CLOSE — 41.2% AWAY (WIDENED FROM 33.3% / ₩466,213 ON JULY 29). HOWEVER, THE MOST IMPORTANT DATA POINT TODAY DOES NOT COME FROM SEOUL: THE SKHY US ADR SURGED 16.9% TO $146.65 DURING US TRADING HOURS (AFTER THE KRX CLOSE) — CREATING A RECORD 60% PREMIUM OVER THE KRX-IMPLIED ADR VALUE (~$92 AT CURRENT KRW/USD RATES AND ADR RATIO). SAMSUNG ELECTRONICS ALSO REPORTED Q2 2026 RESULTS ON THE SAME DAY — BEATING ESTIMATES — CONFIRMING THE MEMORY CYCLE (DRAM PRICING +30%, NAND MID-50%) REMAINS ON TRACK AND THAT SK HYNIX'S REVENUE 'MISS' WAS A TIMING ISSUE (HBM4 SHIPMENT DEFERRAL), NOT A DEMAND SIGNAL. THE KRX SESSION WAS VOLATILE: ₩1,287,000 LOW (TESTED AGAIN — MATCHING JULY 29'S POST-CLOSE INTRADAY LOWS) TO ₩1,459,000 HIGH (SAMSUNG EARNINGS BOUNCE) BEFORE SETTLING TO ₩1,322,000. THE ₩1,287,000 LEVEL HAS NOW HELD AS THE POST-EARNINGS FLOOR ON TWO CONSECUTIVE DAYS — A POTENTIAL DOUBLE-BOTTOM FORMATION. THE FOMC MACRO HEADWIND (10Y YIELD ELEVATED, RISK-OFF POSTURE AMONG FOREIGN INSTITUTIONAL INVESTORS) IS ALSO CONTRIBUTING TO THE KRX DIVERGENCE FROM THE US ADR PRICE.
long_pnl: Framework longs from the gate level (₩1,867,213) are down −₩545,213 / −29.2% at the July 30 close of ₩1,322,000 — the deepest drawdown of the framework period. decision.horizon: 3-6 months; the H2 2026 HBM4 full ramp is the primary re-rating catalyst; the two-day post-earnings selloff has created a fundamental discount that the 60% US ADR premium makes explicit; hold through October Q3 2026 earnings which should show the H2 HBM4 revenue recognition
decision.rationale: The KRX selloff (−14.7% in two days from ₩1,550,000 to ₩1,322,000) is an overreaction to a timing miss, not a fundamental deterioration. SK Hynix's Q2 2026 numbers: ₩79.32T revenue (+51% QoQ, +257% YoY), ₩60.54T operating profit (+557% YoY), 76% operating margin (highest in the history of any semiconductor company), HBM4 mass production confirmed. Today's US ADR surge (SKHY +16.9% to $146.65, 60% premium over KRX-implied ~$92) is the most direct signal available: US institutional investors who have had time to digest the full earnings picture are re-pricing SK Hynix above the KRX consensus-miss reaction. The ₩1,287,000 post-earnings floor has held on two consecutive days, forming a potential double bottom. analysis:
## Technical analysis

### Session overview — Day 2 post-earnings selloff; double-bottom forming at ₩1,287,000

SK Hynix (000660.KS) closed at ₩1,322,000 on 2026-07-30 (KRX session, completed 06:30 UTC), down ₩79,000 / −5.64% from the July 29 KRX close of ₩1,401,000. Day range: ₩1,287,000 (intraday low) to ₩1,459,000 (intraday high), a ₩172,000 / 13.4% intraday swing — the widest single-session range in the post-earnings framework period.

### Two-day post-earnings selloff context

| Session | KRX close | Distance from ₩1,550,000 (pre-earnings) | Cumulative from gate ₩1,867,213 |
|---|---|---|---|
| July 28 (pre-earnings) | ₩1,550,000 | — | −₩317,213 / −17.0% |
| July 29 (earnings day) | ₩1,401,000 | −₩149,000 / −9.61% | −₩466,213 / −25.0% |
| July 30 (Day 2 post-earnings) | ₩1,322,000 | −₩228,000 / −14.7% cumulative | −₩545,213 / −29.2% |

The two-day post-earnings selloff (−14.7% from ₩1,550,000) is the largest post-earnings drawdown in the framework period. However, the US ADR (SKHY at $146.65) implies a KRX share value of ~₩2,107,000 — 59% above today's close and 13% above the framework gate of ₩1,867,213.

### Session narrative — The volatile July 30 KRX session

**Opening and first leg down (KRX open ~00:00–01:00 UTC):** The KRX session opened below July 29's close, reflecting the FOMC hawkish aftershock (three dissents, elevated 10Y yield) and continued post-earnings selling pressure. SK Hynix fell to the ₩1,287,000 intraday low — matching the post-close lows from July 29's extended trading.

**Samsung earnings bounce (mid-session):** Samsung Electronics reported Q2 2026 results beating consensus on DRAM and NAND revenue during the KRX session. The beat triggered broad Korean memory sector buying: SK Hynix bounced sharply from ₩1,287,000 to ₩1,459,000 (intraday spike of +13.4%), and KOSPI reached 5,977 (up ~5.5% from July 29's 5,663).

**Reversal and close (late KRX session):** The bounce failed to sustain. Sellers re-emerged at ₩1,459,000 (approximately July 29's close + 4.1%), and SK Hynix reversed to close at ₩1,322,000 (−5.64%). KOSPI settled −1.1% to approximately 5,601 — only a fraction of the intraday peak. The reversal pattern (gap down → bounce on catalyst → fail and close near the low) is a classic 'dead cat bounce' structure.

**US ADR reaction (US trading hours, after KRX close):** After the KRX session ended, SKHY (NASDAQ ADR) surged 16.9% to $146.65 driven by: (1) Microsoft Azure +43% macro catalyst (Nasdaq +2.8%); (2) Re-evaluation of SK Hynix Q2 earnings fundamentals by US buy-side analysts; (3) Samsung earnings beat read-through. The 60% ADR premium is the session's most important data point.

### Volume — Elevated but inconclusive

The 13.4% intraday swing (₩1,287,000–₩1,459,000) on a day when KOSPI was volatile (5,547–5,977 range) indicates elevated volume from both retail capitulation (the selloff) and institutional covering (the Samsung bounce). The close at ₩1,322,000 (near the session low, not the mid-point) suggests sellers dominated the final hour of trading despite the mid-session bounce. The key volume signal: the ₩1,287,000 test absorbed sellers on TWO consecutive days — the double-bottom requires this volume absorption pattern to confirm as a floor.

### Trend — In a post-earnings downtrend with double-bottom forming

The primary KRX trend for SK Hynix since July 29 is down (−14.7% in two sessions). The 200-DMA for SK Hynix (not disclosed in search data but estimated based on the framework context to be in the ₩1,600,000–₩1,700,000 range given the stock was above ₩2,000,000 earlier in the year) is likely well above current prices. The short-term trend is clearly bearish. However, the double-bottom at ₩1,287,000 and the 60% US ADR premium are diverging signals that suggest the KRX trend may be near a reversal point.

### US ADR premium — The 60% divergence as a technical indicator

The SKHY ADR premium over KRX-implied value has moved from:
- Pre-earnings (July 28): ~28% premium (from the ts2.tech article on the $750B supply initiative)
- July 29 KRX earnings day: ADR fell 8.79% to ~$126.79; KRX fell 9.61% to ₩1,401,000
- July 30: ADR surged 16.9% to $146.65; KRX fell 5.64% to ₩1,322,000 → 60% premium

The widening ADR premium (from 28% to 60% in two days) is directionally consistent with the 'KRX is wrong, ADR is right' hypothesis. In analogous situations for large-cap stocks with both Korean KRX listings and US ADRs, the ADR premium tends to lead KRX price discovery within 5–10 trading sessions.
